logic.thread_summary: This video provides a series of instructions for planting and caring for maize, including land preparation, spacing, fertilization, and pest control.

logical_links.link: After ensuring the land is clear of weeds, it is important to properly space the maize plants to allow for optimal growth.
The recommended spacing of 60 cm by 30 cm is crucial for the plants to receive adequate nutrients and sunlight, which is why DAP 18460 should be applied 10 days after sowing.
After the 10th day, the maize plants will have established themselves, making it the right time to apply NPK2320 or CAF fertilizers 55 days after sowing.
Once the maize plants have grown for 55 days, they are more vulnerable to pests, which is why it is important to control full armyworm with MRONDAT-TSC or escort.
After addressing pest control, it is necessary to ensure the land remains free of weeds by applying selective herbicides.
